Original values are saved on the computer before each new cleanup. Repeated clicks keep the first backup. External changes are reported as conflicts.
Start the included ADB helper on your computer and keep it open. Only an authorised computer can perform system changes. The APK alone can inspect and record tests.
Based on CleanYourTV (MIT), with Home switching, advertising checks and recovery ported from the Aerial custom build. Updates require the same custom signing key.
Disable the Xiaomi idle screensaver? Its clock, weather and photo screen will also stop. The original state will be saved first.
Restore the saved original state of this cleanup? This may enable the original screensaver again.
